verdict.rationale: Firebase documents its own programmatic surfaces. Firestore offers a MongoDB-compatible API usable with existing drivers. The Authentication SDK provides methods to create and manage users, and the Admin SDK is named as a way to invoke backend functions. Community users also reference calling Firebase via its REST API. However, the pack has no first-party REST/API reference, the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and no control-plane API for driving projects or configuration is evidenced; the MCP server and CLI belong to other stories. Missing for 10: a documented first-party REST API reference, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, a public management/control-plane API for projects and configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven usage.
